items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet. The read-only security baseline reports fleet-doctor unavailable, no site checks, and unknown legal-family/security facts for all 59 in-scope sites. No evidence supports a clean bill of health. Ordinary growth may continue, but security-sensitive releases require targeted evidence first.

SearchWoot security disposition: blocked for public beta. Authentication, secret handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency risk, data exposure, incident readiness, TLS evidence, and disclosure readiness are incomplete. Exact decision: keep private; permit only bounded read-only evidence capture. Do not expose data, add credentials, change configuration, monetize, deploy, or launch.

items.title: Complete fleet security baseline evidence

items.requested_action: Approve read-only evidence capture only. Do not block ordinary growth for optional hardening, and do not treat unavailable checks as passing. Escalate any confirmed high-severity control failure to CTO and CEO before affected security-sensitive release.
